scope: Source inputs captured unchanged before and after the 2026-10-21 720p gallery preview renders; see preview-validation-2026-10-21.json for exact ranges and review limits.

collection.imports: Conservative relative-import closure from the actual examples/cases.tsx entry point. Other templates/effect demos are included because that entry point imports them. Bare package imports are represented by package.json and package-lock.json.
collection.runtimeMedia: Selected fixture photos and soundtrack/beat map, plus every local face in the selected template font modules. Font file paths are deduplicated. Declared runtime publicPrefixes capture art, effects and narration; additional catalog tracks are included. Music bytes are hashed locally, never copied into public assets.
collection.provenance: Selected template catalog and soundtrack provenance are also captured; they may be broader than direct renderer inputs.
collection.distinctFromProjectFingerprint: This legacy public-preview algorithm hashes UTF-8 path + NUL + raw file bytes + NUL in sorted path order. scripts/render-support.mjs instead hashes path + NUL + binary SHA256(file bytes), with a different project-wide inventory.
collection.limitations: The closure follows statically discoverable relative imports. It is not a browser network trace; installed dependency bytes and Chromium/OS binaries are not hashed.
